purpose: Baseline for the command/tool/schema SFT. Every number below is a property of THIS checkpoint. An SFT re-fits the AWQ calibration and rebuilds the engines, so all of it must be re-measured before anything is republished.

calibration.note: Every distance number below is stated WITH its calibration. The original freeze gave distance_pct=18.52 without saying it was k=1, and the Phase 6 re-measure then produced three defensible verdicts (SFT better at k=1, worse at global k, worse-but-not-significant at per-bucket k) with no way to tell which one the gate meant. A distance gate is meaningless without its k.
calibration.gate_basis_reason: Global k is what a deployment ships: one constant, fitted once, applied to every reading. k=1 measures an uncalibrated model nobody deploys, and per-bucket k needs the ground-truth range to pick the bucket, which at inference is the unknown being estimated.
calibration.k_estimator: split-half median of gt/pred on even/odd positions of the id-sorted distance items; halves scored with the other half's k

gates_L1.caveat_tolerant_entities: Label-fidelity numbers computed before the 2026-09-12 fix to tolerant_entities() are measuring the parser, not the model: it lost the label of every entity after the first, 100% of the time (the tail span ran to the next 'bbox_2d', so later head spans were empty and fell back to 'object'). Re-measure before citing them.

holdout_never_train: the 1,442 L0 items including the 500 left_right
